title: Syria Announces First Cabinet Reshuffle Since Assad's Ouster
detail: Syria's transitional government announced its first cabinet reshuffle since the ouster of Bashar al-Assad, according to Syrian state media cited by Reuters. The reshuffle marks a significant step in the consolidation of the new administration led by Ahmed al-Sharaa (Abu Mohammed al-Jolani), as the government works to stabilize governance and address international concerns about the transition. Specific ministerial changes were reported via state media on May 9, 2026.

media.caption: Syria announces first cabinet reshuffle since fall of Assad regime
